title: Qwdrama
wikitext:
[[qwdrama]] was a QuakeWorld community website founded in [[2006]] by [[XantoM]] which aimed at providing fresh news and resources to the QuakeWorld community. The site was shut down in 2009 due to inactivity. The sister sites and an archived version of the site is now hosted at QuakeWorld.nu (thanks to Zalon).
